summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests TRE-515, a pill-form drug that works by inhibiting deoxycytidine kinase (dCK), in adults with advanced solid tumors. TRE-515 is taken by mouth once daily, at about the same time each day, at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after eating, with no breaks between cycles, and continues as long as the cancer does not progress, side effects stay acceptable, and the sponsor and study doctor agree it is in the patient's best interest. The main goal is to measure the safety of TRE-515 and the highest dose that can be tolerated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa TRE-515, un medicamento en cápsulas que actúa inhibiendo la desoxicitidina cinasa (dCK), en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. TRE-515 se toma por vía oral una vez al día, a más o menos la misma hora cada día, al menos 1 hora antes o 2 horas después de comer, sin pausas entre ciclos, y continúa mientras el cáncer no progrese, los efectos secundarios sean aceptables y el patrocinador y el médico del estudio consideren que es lo mejor para el paciente. El objetivo principal es medir la seguridad de TRE-515 y la dosis más alta que puede tolerarse.
who_for: Histologically or cytologically confirmed solid tumor that is advanced and refractory, with no effective standard treatment left
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1, or a positive known marker of progression (such as PSA or CA-125) if no measurable disease
Age 18 or older and able to give signed informed consent
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function, and willingness to use contraception during study and for 3 months after last dose
not_for: Other active cancers, with listed exceptions
Known HIV, or active hepatitis B or C infection
Significant heart problems, heart attack within 6 months, or stroke or transient ischemic attack within 6 months
